question: Who among the following was the founder of the Shunga Dynasty (185 BC - 73 BC) ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pushyamitra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **Shunga Dynasty**

__
 
• It was founded by Pushyamitra. There were ten Shunga rulers. 
 
• Their capital was Patliputra.
 
• Pushyamitra was the commander of the last Mauryan emperor Vrihadratha.
 
• Pushyamitra killed the last emperor Vrihadrata and occupied the whole of Magadha.
 
• The name of the first ruler of the Mauryan dynasty of Magadha was also Brihadratha and the name of the last ruler was also Vrihadratha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Agnimitra

 
 
• Agnimitra was the son of Pushyamitra Sunga.
 
• He ruled the Sunga Empire from 149 BC to 141 BC.
 
• By the time Agnimitra succeeded to the throne, the Vidarbha region broke away from the Sunga empire and became independent.
 
• He is mentioned in Kalidasa’s most acclaimed poem Malavikagnimitram.
 
• After Agnimitra, his son Sujyeshta and his son Vasumitra succeeded to the throne.
